tip: Snow 'comes' in Korean: 첫눈이 왔어요 (cheonnuni wasseoyo = the first snow came). Rain too – 비가 와요 (biga wayo = it rains). There is no single verb 'to snow' or 'to rain'.
Only the last verb takes past tense: 비가 와서 축구를 취소했어요 (biga waseo chukgureul chwisohaesseoyo). 와서 (waseo) stays tense-free even though the rain already happened – -서 never takes 었 (-eot).
